page.overview:
What is Virtual Informative Pig?

, also known as VIP, is a digital version of Very Informative Pig that resides in the MOE.

Virtual Informative Pig is the same design as Very Informative Pig, that is of a pink cartoon pig with large round glasses, a black top hat, a black suit jacket with buttons, and a loose red tie. He has small eyes, two pig-like ears, a pig snout, and two hooves for feet.

Virtual Informative Pig is much kinder than Very Informative Pig with him trying to help Devon to beat Very Informative Pig.
